data.name: Najihah
data.gender_notes: Najihah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Najihah is an Arabic female name, which in Islamic tradition means 'successful'. This is derived from the Quranic word 'Najah' in Surah Al-Fajr (89:16). The name Najihah carries the meaning “Successful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Najihah usually hope their child will grow to embody successful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who achieves success through faith and determination.
data.etymology: Najihah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Successful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Najihah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_urdu.name: ناجیہہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: اللہ تعالیٰ نے اس کے لیے خیر الاولیاء کے نام سے منتخب کیا ہے ۔ ایسی خاتون جس کے لئے انصافاء کرنے کے قابل ہوں ۔ اس طرح اللہ تعالیٰ نے اسے ناجیہہ کی شان بخشی ہے تاکہ وہ خیر الاولیاء کے نام سے جانا جائے

in_hindi.name: नाज़ीहा
in_hindi.long_meaning: अल्लाह ने इसे खीर अल-आलिया (सही रास्ते पर रहने वालों के लिए सबसे अच्छा) के नाम से चुना है। यह वह महिला है जिसके लिए दूसरे مرد खासतौर से सलाह देते हैं। अल्लाह ने इसे नाज़ीहा नाम दिया है ताकि वह सही रास्ते पर रहने वालों के लिए सबसे अच्छी हो

in_pashto.name: ناجيهه

In Islamic tradition, the name Najihah is associated with the qualities of wisdom, compassion, and kindness. Women with this name are believed to possess these virtues and are often seen as role models in their communities.
